quest.title: Guest from Afar
quest.description: Lately, there's been some suspicious activity seen around Wangshu Inn. Verr Goldet is anxious about the inn's safety...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Something about this area just unsettles me. I can't quite explain it.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: It doesn't help that all our guests seem to be the hypervigilant types too...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: If there's the slightest disturbance, we end up with broken windows and doors, sometimes broken floorboards too.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Thankfully the guests do sort the repairs out themselves. But these piecemeal repairs have left us with an assortment of different bits and pieces that don't go together, and it just looks horrendous.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Could you take a look around outside the inn? If you find anything untoward, just... sort it out. I need to look after the guests.

choices.text: What is wrong with these people...

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Oh come on, they're not that bad! They're just used to being in survival mode out in the wilderness. You can't blame them for being on high alert.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Please, just take a look around the vicinity. I'm sure you won't encounter anything too disastrous.

talks.objective: Go and check the suspicious location

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Don't take too long. The guests are more likely to overreact to any disturbances once night sets in.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Wonderful. Tonight will be a peaceful night.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Please accept these as compensation for your trouble.
